description: This file defines the class OCIContainerImplementation, which implements container management functionalities such as starting, stopping, and querying containers, as well as handling container events. It also includes nested classes and methods related to container event dispatching and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: OCIContainerImplementation
classes.description: A class implementing container lifecycle management and event handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture, supporting operations like start, stop, and query, as well as event dispatching and notification management.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class within OCIContainerImplementation that represents a dispatchable job for container event handling, supporting creation, dispatch, and reference counting.
